versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-cron-service — effortless scheduled jobs with managed billing and spend caps.

- Run agents on a cron schedule with no need for your own server, database, or scheduler.
- Ensures exactly-once, idempotent billing per scheduled execution, with optional per-fire and per-day spend caps.
- Simple setup with the settlemesh CLI and a one-time human login or API key.
- Supports creating, managing, and monitoring scheduled jobs and their histories.
- Built-in guardrails auto-pause runaway jobs to prevent overspending.
